title: The New Covenant Inaugurated: Mark
subtitle: Mark 1-16
theme: The servant King acts. Urgency, authority, and the suffering Son of Man.
memoryText: For even the Son of Man came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.
reviewQuestions: What is the “Messianic secret” in Mark?
Why does Mark’s Gospel move so quickly?
How does Mark’s Gospel build toward the cross as its climax?
What does Mark’s Passion narrative add to the other Gospels?
psalmsNote: Psalms read beside Mark’s stories: 107:23-43 (the storm), 89 (the Davidic king), 118:19-29 (the cornerstone), and 69 (the righteous sufferer).
